name: Technisches Museum Wien
notes: Listing page has no dates, only links to /ausstellung/<slug> detail pages (9 of them). Each detail page has an ExhibitionEvent JSON-LD block with start/end; some blocks contain unescaped control chars so json.loads needs strict=False. Descriptions are double HTML-escaped (e.g. &lt;sup&gt;), so ea.text() is applied twice. No admission price found on detail pages, so price_min/price_text left null (general museum ticket applies, amount not stated here).
